# Julian Hilgemann — Data Platform Engineer

> Portfolio and technical documentation for Julian Hilgemann, a data platform engineer building the systems between a measurement and a decision: Microsoft Fabric and Azure platforms, models and warehouses, forecasting, and the expressive work that runs the same pipeline backwards. English only; the German pages that remain are the legal ones.
> Updated: Oct 2026

## Core Pages (English)
- [Home](/docs/index.md): Landing page: positioning statement and the current project, the FX Macro Data Platform, with its architecture.
- [Story](/docs/story.md): The narrative spine of the site: seven chapters from signal through belief, measurement, structure, inference and the number, then back out as expansion.
- [Projects](/docs/projects.md): Open-source data projects: analytics engineering, forecasting, data visualisation and creative coding, each with concept and architecture.
- [Work](/docs/work.md): Short CV: multi-tenant Microsoft Fabric product work, semantic model scale, TMDL and Git-based workflow, and the earlier fintech forecasting background.
- [Services & Pricing](/docs/services.md): Service packages, deliverables, engineering and design standards, and the interactive pricing calculator.
- [Page Engine](/docs/page-engine.md): Technical architecture of the decision engine: signal ingestion, modeling, forecasting, and delivery layers.
- [Link Hub](/docs/hub.md): Contact and profile links: GitHub, LinkedIn, and a downloadable vCard.

## Legal & Site Utilities
- [Impressum](/docs/impressum.md): Legal notice under § 5 TMG: operator identity, address, and contact.
- [Privacy Policy](/docs/datenschutz.md): GDPR privacy policy: hosting, Google Analytics 4 consent handling, data categories, third-country transfers, and data subject rights.
- [Cookie Settings](/docs/cookie-einstellungen.md): Cookie preference management.
- [Impressum (DE)](/docs/de/impressum.md): German legal notice under § 5 TMG.
- [Datenschutz (DE)](/docs/de/datenschutz.md): German GDPR privacy policy.
- [Cookie-Einstellungen (DE)](/docs/de/cookie-einstellungen.md): German cookie preference management.
